entities.name: Pili
entities.description: A goblin scout with a damaged back leg who joined Gideon's forces during the Battle for Zendikar.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: Planeswalker and commander of the forces fighting the Eldrazi on Zendikar.

entities.name: Leek
entities.description: Pili's goblin friend, crushed by a rockfall in the goblin hideout near Sea Gate.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: Planeswalker who mourned losing her contact with Zendikar's world-soul and helped Pili and the trapped goblins.

entities.name: Munda
entities.description: An ally who helped Nissa kill the Eldrazi and clear the cave-in, then told the goblins of Gideon's plan.

entities.name: Sea Gate
entities.description: Zendikar city near which the goblin hideout lay; Gideon planned to reclaim it.

entities.name: Sky Rock
entities.description: Place where the injured goblins were carried.

entities.name: Dojir Nomads
entities.description: Nomads who picked Pili up on their way from the Calcite Flats.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Alien invaders of Zendikar whose lesser spawn chased Pili and killed Leek.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane invaded by the Eldrazi.

events.summary: Pili, newly revived by Gideon's healers, raves about her friend Leek, lost at Sea Gate; the Dojir Nomads had picked her up.
events.quote: She was picked up by the Dojir Nomads on their way over from the Calcite Flats.

events.summary: Pili runs past Nissa pursued by lesser Eldrazi; Nissa, aided by Munda, kills them all.
events.quote: Nissa faced the creatures and, aided by Munda , killed them all.

events.summary: Pili finds the goblin hideout collapsed and Leek dead, crushed by a rockfall.
events.quote: Leek was one of three to have been crushed by a rockfall inside the ruin.

events.summary: Nissa and Munda dig out the trapped goblins, and Munda tells them of Gideon and the plan to reclaim Sea Gate.
events.quote: With careful work and patience, Nissa and Munde cleared away the cave-in, and the goblins made their way out.

events.summary: Pili blames herself for Leek's death, swears vengeance on the Eldrazi and storms off to join Gideon.
events.quote: Her sorrow turned to vengeance, and she swore violent vengeance on the Eldrazi that had killed her friend, then stormed off to join Gideon.
